Hi Susan — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

- What we heard: Cedarline is comfortable with vendor attestation but needs our SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or a bridge letter if the report is older than 12 months. GDPR and HIPAA scoping were discussed — Cedarline will confirm whether PHI is in scope for their integration.
- What we need from your side: latest SOC 2 Type II (PDF) or a signed bridge letter, and access to a secure location (trust portal or SFTP) where you can upload compliance artifacts.
- Our ask / timing: if possible, could you share the SOC2 report or bridge letter by EOD Friday (Dec 4)? If that’s tight, confirm by Thursday with expected delivery date so we can keep procurement and legal on track.

I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and our bridge letter template for reference (legal will want to review any bridge edits). To simplify transfers we can provision a temporary trust portal invite — I’ll loop Marissa to create the invite if you prefer that route.

Thanks — we’ll treat everything as confidential.

Best,
Aditya Rao

If you need an initial artifact for procurement to start the review, I can send a redacted SOC2 PDF tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
